items.headline: Why Flexsteel Industries Shares Are Trading Higher By 9%; Here Are 20 Stocks Moving Premarket
items.summary: Flexsteel Industries Inc (FLXS) reported better-than-expected Q4 results, with shares jumping 9% in pre-market trading. Other gainers include PFSA, EJH, XOS, WETO, SGLY, VOGX, WFF, AMLX, and ENRD. Losers include SNYR, XPON, NOMA, BTAI, and YOUL.
